text:
jord: Noticed a spike of SCIM 403s from Okta after the KMS key rotation. Example log shows JWE unwrap failing due to invalid UTF-8 in payload. Anyone else seeing this?

neha: Yikes. Can you paste the raw log line? is it failing for all tenants or a subset?

jord: Paste: 
```
2026-03-23T11:01:17Z ERROR scim-worker: tenant=zephyr op=create_user status=403 err="kms:unwrap failed" details="jwe_decode: bad_payload: invalid_utf8 '\ud83d'"
payload: {externalId: "zephyr|u|789", nameID: "Miyë \ud83c\udf1f"}
```

tariq: That payload has emoji and a combining diaeresis. Our JWE payload is expected to be UTF-8 JSON. After the KMS vendor pushed stricter decoding checks in their SDK v4.12, malformed or non-normalized Unicode is rejected. Past encoders tolerated NFD sequences.

neha: Which service did the rotation? infra-bot, did the KMS SDK roll go out this morning?

infra-bot: KMS provider SDK v4.12.0 rolled to prod at 2026-03-23T05:02:00Z in regions us-east-1, eu-west-1.

jord: Affected tenants so far: zephyr, lunr, acme-proto (small fraction of users with non-latin names).

neha: Short term mitigation ideas? We should avoid blocking provisioning for entire tenant.

tariq: Options: 1) Enable passthrough (disable JWE envelope) for backlog queue for impacted tenants. 2) Hotfix: add NFC normalization + strict UTF-8 encoding step before JWE encode; return 400 locally if normalization still fails. 3) Backfill: requeue failed creates with normalization applied.

neha: Also need better audit/events for compliance. Right now fails are logged as 403+generic. We should emit structured audit event with fields: event_type="provision_kms_unwrap_error", error_subcode="invalid_utf8", tenant_id, redacted_externalId. That will help SOC and legal.

jord: Agreed. I can toggle passthrough for zephyr while you prepare a patch. Who can own the hotfix?

tariq: I'll take the hotfix. Plan: add normalizer util using ICU Normalizer to NFC, remove control chars <0x20 except tab/newline, then serialize JSON and utf8-encode. Add unit tests: namecases with emoji, combining accents, and legacy NFD names. CI should include a vendor-sdk toggle to simulate strict decode.

neha: Add one more safety: when building JWE, ensure protected header does not include any user-controlled fields; move all user values to payload. If any upstream code adds typ/usermeta to header, fail CI.

jord: Good call. Also add a canary rollout: push hotfix to provisioning-staging, run canary against synthetic Okta payloads with diacritics and emoji. If unwrap error rate drops, promote.

infra-bot: Canary job created: canary-provisioner-emoji-tests run scheduled.

neha: For vulnerability triage: this is not a key compromise but it is a functional regression causing DoS for some users. Mark P2 and add to weekly vuln sync. Add mitigation steps and timeline in the ticket.

jord: I'll file an incident ticket and include tenant list + sample logs + recommended runbook (passthrough toggle, contact tenant SEs).

oncall: When incident page is live, page oncall if >10 fails/min for same tenant. Also add runbook step: check KMS SDK version and revert to v4.11 if hotfix can't ship in <4h.

tariq: I'll open PR now. Will include migration script to requeue failed messages with normalization and mark original attempts in audit as "requeued_for_normalization".

neha: Thanks. jord, ping me with the incident link. I'll coordinate audit schema change with compliance.

jord: Incident INC-2026-2240 opened and assigned. Thanks team.
